svg.title: Chance to cross Rough ground at full speed, by Training Tier
svg.desc: An Athletics roll (Earth plus Difficulty) at Difficulty 5, 6, 7 and 8, for the four test characters at every Training Tier. Untrained ignores Earth, so all four share one number. Adept, Expert and Master are identical here. At every Difficulty shown, a Novice Frankie does worse than an Untrained one: at Difficulty 7, 11 percent against 21.
svg.text: Chance to cross Rough ground at full speed, by Training Tier
Athletics: Earth + Difficulty. Exact odds, checked against 100,000 rolls per cell.
